'''pointy-eared green dude Matt's Kind Of Scum''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[pointy-eared green dude]]
* '''Published:''' 24 January 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|My Kind Of Scum / Fearless And Inventive|JPSD-D-mykindofscum.gif|label=My Kind Of Scum}}
* '''Strategy:''' My Kind Of Scum
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTheed MKOS dude DS 2003 MattsKin.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

This is my brother's deck.  I've beaten it many times, and he's tired of it.  How can it be any better???

== Strategy ==

My brother likes to pull off a retrieval 11, lose 11 with Boonta Eve Podrace and Watto's Box.

3/4 of Interrupts deal with podracing and become good destiny only after the podrace.  What does he need?

After that, it is pretty much a power struggle on Tatooine...

Main Question:  What should I be able to do after the podrace???

He needs some help, and I know you guys can give it.  Any feedback would be greatly appreciated.  Be kind with the rating if it is to be horrible...this is my brother's deck, not mine.  Thanks again!
